==Description==
'''Silly''' is a sticker unlocked by reaching Level 24 of the regular track in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. At that Level, it cost {{Bunz|780}} or {{Robux|108}}. The total cost was {{Bunz|8,890}} or {{Robux|1,960}}.

==Appearance==
The sticker showcases the default Level 4 [[Medic]] sticking its tongue out while it has its hands on its head.

==Trivia==
*This sticker is a reference to [[w:c:yua:Yoriko Nikaidō|Yoriko Nikaidou]] in the [[w:c:yua:You're Under Arrest (OVA)|You're Under Arrest OVA]].
